pages.title: Before You Decide
pages.text: Severe injuries can heal with meat or ordinary dragon meal: $(l:dragonmaid:care/injury)Keep caring$(/l). Mercy killing causes permanent death.$(br2)Only the owner may use the blade on their severely injured dragon at zero health. Check its name; Cancel or Esc is safe.

pages.title: Crafting the Blade
pages.text: Place a scale lower left and bone one slot diagonally above right. The pair may be moved anywhere. The blade cannot heal.

pages.title: Permanent Death
pages.text: After confirmation, the dragon dies permanently and can be harvested. Blood and scales cannot be harvested while it is severely injured.$(br2)Mercy killing cannot be undone or used to restore health.
